ko.title: 독해 13위, 수학 27위: 미국이 20년 만에 최악의 PISA 점수를 기록한 진짜 의미

segments.src: ## A Sobering Report Card for American Teens
segments.tr: ## 미국 청소년들의 씁쓸한 성적표

segments.src: Every three years, hundreds of thousands of 15-year-olds around the world sit down for the Programme for International Student Assessment, or PISA — a standardized test run by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) that compares how students in dozens of countries perform in reading, math, and science.
segments.tr: 3년마다 전 세계 수십만 명의 15세 학생들이 국제학업성취도평가(PISA)를 치릅니다. 이는 경제협력개발기구(OECD)가 주관하는 표준화된 시험으로, 수십 개국 학생들의 독해, 수학, 과학 성취도를 비교합니다.

segments.src: The latest round of results has landed with a thud in US education circles.
segments.tr: 최근 발표된 결과는 미국 교육계에 큰 충격을 안겼습니다.

segments.src: American teenagers posted a reading rank of 13th and a math rank of 27th among participating education systems, according to the newest data — scores that put the country at or near its lowest standing in more than twenty years of testing.
segments.tr: 최신 데이터에 따르면, 미국 청소년들은 참여 교육 시스템 중 독해 13위, 수학 27위를 기록했습니다. 이는 20년이 넘는 시험 역사상 가장 낮거나 그에 근접한 수준입니다.

segments.src: For a nation that has long framed itself as a global leader in innovation and higher education, the numbers have reignited a familiar but increasingly urgent question: what's going wrong in K-12 classrooms?
segments.tr: 오랫동안 스스로를 혁신과 고등 교육의 글로벌 리더로 규정해 온 국가로서는, 이 수치로 인해 익숙하지만 점점 더 시급해지는 질문이 다시 제기되고 있습니다. 바로 K-12 교실에서 무엇이 잘못되고 있는가 하는 점입니다.

segments.src: ## Reading Holds Up Better Than Math
segments.tr: ## 수학보다 선방한 독해

segments.src: The split between the two subjects is telling.
segments.tr: 두 과목 간의 격차는 시사하는 바가 큽니다.

segments.src: A 13th-place reading rank isn't a disaster on its own — many countries cluster tightly in the middle of the pack, and small score differences can shuffle rankings significantly.
segments.tr: 독해 13위라는 순위 자체는 재앙이 아닙니다. 많은 국가가 중간 그룹에 촘촘히 모여 있어 작은 점수 차이로도 순위가 크게 뒤바뀔 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Math is a different story.
segments.tr: 수학은 이야기가 다릅니다.

segments.src: A 27th-place finish places the US behind most other advanced economies and well below the OECD average, continuing a slide that predates the pandemic but appears to have accelerated sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: 27위라는 성적은 미국을 대부분의 다른 선진국 뒤에 위치시키며 OECD 평균을 훨씬 밑도는 수준으로, 팬데믹 이전부터 시작되어 최근 몇 년 동안 급격히 가속화된 하락세를 이어가고 있습니다.

segments.src: Education researchers point to a mix of contributing factors rather than a single cause:
segments.tr: 교육 연구원들은 단일 원인보다는 여러 기여 요인이 복합적으로 작용한 결과라고 지적합니다.

segments.src: - **Pandemic-era disruption.** Extended remote and hybrid learning during 2020 and 2021 is widely believed to have interrupted the steady, sequential skill-building that math in particular requires.
segments.tr: - **팬데믹 시기의 혼란.** 2020년과 2021년 동안 장기화된 원격 및 하이브리드 수업이 특히 수학에서 요구되는 꾸준하고 단계적인 기술 습득을 방해한 것으로 널리 여겨집니다.

segments.src: - **Chronic absenteeism.** Attendance data in many districts has not fully recovered to pre-pandemic levels, and missed classroom time compounds quickly in math, where each concept builds on the last.
segments.tr: - **만성적인 결석.** 많은 학군의 등교율이 팬데믹 이전 수준으로 완전히 회복되지 않았으며, 수업 결손은 이전 개념을 바탕으로 다음 단계로 나아가는 수학 과목에서 빠르게 누적됩니다.

segments.src: - **Uneven recovery efforts.** Federal relief funding aimed at academic recovery has largely expired, and results have varied widely by state and district, suggesting no single intervention has closed the gap nationally.
segments.tr: - **일관되지 않은 회복 노력.** 학업 회복을 목표로 했던 연방 구호 기금이 대부분 만료되었고, 결과는 주와 학군에 따라 크게 달라 전국적으로 격차를 줄인 단일 개입 조치는 없었음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: - **Widening gaps between students.** Multiple assessments, including domestic tests like the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), have shown that lower-performing students fell further behind during this period, which can drag down national averages even when top performers hold steady.
segments.tr: - **학생 간 격차 확대.** 학업성취도평가(NAEP)와 같은 국내 시험을 포함한 여러 평가에서 이 기간 동안 하위권 학생들의 학력 저하가 더 심해진 것으로 나타났으며, 이는 상위권 학생들이 버텨주더라도 국가 평균을 끌어내릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Economists Are Paying Attention
segments.tr: ## 경제학자들이 주목하는 이유

segments.src: PISA scores aren't just a matter of academic pride.
segments.tr: PISA 점수는 단순히 학업적 자존심의 문제가 아닙니다.

segments.src: Economists who study human capital have long argued that a country's long-run productivity and competitiveness track closely with the math and problem-solving skills of its workforce.
segments.tr: 인적 자본을 연구하는 경제학자들은 한 국가의 장기적인 생산성과 경쟁력이 노동 인구의 수학 및 문제 해결 능력과 밀접하게 연관되어 있다고 오랫동안 주장해 왔습니다.

segments.src: As industries increasingly lean on data analysis, automation, and technical trades, a generation entering the workforce with weaker quantitative foundations could face a harder time filling — or being prepared for — higher-skilled, higher-wage jobs.
segments.tr: 산업계가 데이터 분석, 자동화, 기술 직종에 점점 더 의존함에 따라, 양적 기초 체력이 약한 세대가 노동 시장에 진입하면 고숙련·고임금 일자리를 채우거나 이에 대비하는 데 더 큰 어려움을 겪을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Business groups and workforce-development organizations have flagged this concern in recent years, noting that employers already report difficulty finding applicants with adequate math and technical readiness for skilled roles, from manufacturing to healthcare technology.
segments.tr: 비즈니스 단체와 인력 개발 기관들은 최근 몇 년 동안 이러한 우려를 제기해 왔으며, 고용주들이 이미 제조업에서 헬스케어 기술에 이르기까지 숙련된 역할을 수행할 수 있는 적절한 수학적 및 기술적 준비가 된 지원자를 찾는 데 어려움을 겪고 있다고 보고했습니다.

segments.src: A prolonged dip in foundational math skills, some economists caution, could show up years from now as a drag on productivity growth rather than an immediate crisis.
segments.tr: 일부 경제학자들은 기초 수학 능력의 장기적인 저하가 즉각적인 위기라기보다는 수년 후에 생산성 성장률을 떨어뜨리는 요인으로 나타날 수 있다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Debate, With New Urgency
segments.tr: ## 새로운 시급성을 띤 익숙한 논쟁

segments.src: The results have renewed a long-running debate among educators, parents, and policymakers over how to respond.
segments.tr: 이번 결과는 교육자, 학부모, 정책 입안자들 사이에서 어떻게 대응할 것인가를 두고 오래된 논쟁을 재점화했습니다.

segments.src: Some argue for doubling down on high-dosage tutoring programs, which have shown promise in randomized studies for accelerating math recovery.
segments.tr: 일부는 수학 학업 회복을 가속화하는 데 있어 무작위 연구를 통해 효과가 입증된 고강도 튜터링 프로그램을 대폭 강화해야 한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Others point to curriculum standards, teacher shortages in STEM subjects, and the growing presence of smartphones and social media in classrooms as areas needing attention.
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 교육과정 표준, STEM 과목의 교사 부족, 교실 내 스마트폰 및 소셜 미디어의 증가 등을 주목해야 할 영역으로 지적합니다.

segments.src: There is broad agreement on at least one point: there is no single fix, and any recovery will likely take years, not one school cycle, to materialize in test scores.
segments.tr: 적어도 한 가지 점에는 광범위한 합의가 존재합니다. 단 하나의 해결책은 없으며, 학업 회복이 시험 점수로 나타나기까지는 단 한 번의 학기 주기가 아니라 수년이 걸릴 것이라는 점입니다.

segments.src: It's also worth noting that the US has never topped PISA rankings, even in stronger years — a mix of income inequality, decentralized school funding, and demographic diversity has long made direct comparisons with smaller, more centralized education systems tricky.
segments.tr: 미국이 성적이 좋았던 해에도 PISA 순위에서 정상을 차지한 적이 없다는 점도 주목할 만합니다. 소득 불평등, 분권화된 학교 재정, 인구학적 다양성으로 인해 규모가 작고 더 중앙집권화된 교육 시스템과의 직접적인 비교는 오랫동안 까다로웠습니다.

segments.src: Still, the direction of the trend, rather than the absolute rank, is what has caught the attention of researchers: a consistent decline over multiple testing cycles is harder to dismiss as noise.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 연구자들의 이목을 끈 것은 절대적인 순위보다는 추세의 방향입니다. 여러 시험 주기 동안 지속적인 하락세를 보인 것은 단순한 일시적 잡음으로 치부하기 어렵기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: Expect the new scores to feature heavily in state and local budget debates over the next school year, as districts weigh how to allocate shrinking pandemic-relief dollars toward tutoring, literacy coaching, and math intervention programs.
segments.tr: 각 학군이 줄어드는 팬데믹 구호 자금을 튜터링, 읽기 쓰기 지도, 수학 개입 프로그램에 어떻게 배분할지 고민함에 따라, 새로운 점수 결과는 다음 학년도의 주 및 지역 예산 논쟁에서 비중 있게 다뤄질 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: Parents may also see more schools experimenting with phone-free classroom policies and revised math curricula aimed at rebuilding foundational skills earlier.
segments.tr: 학부모들은 더 많은 학교가 스마트폰 없는 교실 정책을 실험하고, 더 이른 시기에 기초 능력을 재건하기 위해 개정된 수학 교육과정을 도입하는 것을 보게 될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: For now, the PISA results serve as a data point rather than a verdict — a reminder that the pandemic's effects on education are still working their way through the system, and that closing the gap will likely require sustained attention well beyond the next test cycle in three years.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 PISA 결과가 최종 판결이라기보다는 하나의 데이터 포인트 역할을 하고 있습니다. 이는 팬데믹이 교육에 미친 영향이 여전히 시스템 전반에 작용하고 있으며, 격차를 줄이기 위해서는 3년 뒤의 다음 시험 주기를 훨씬 넘어서는 지속적인 관심이 필요할 것임을 상기시켜 줍니다.

zh.title: 阅读第13，数学第27：美国二十年来最差的 PISA 成绩究竟意味着什么

segments.src: ## A Sobering Report Card for American Teens
segments.tr: ## 给美国青少年的令人清醒的成绩单

segments.src: Every three years, hundreds of thousands of 15-year-olds around the world sit down for the Programme for International Student Assessment, or PISA — a standardized test run by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) that compares how students in dozens of countries perform in reading, math, and science.
segments.tr: 每三年，全球成千上万名 15 岁的学生都会坐下来参加国际学生评估项目（PISA）——这是一项由经济合作与发展组织（OECD）主办的标准化测试，旨在比较数十个国家和地区学生在阅读、数学和科学方面的表现。

segments.src: The latest round of results has landed with a thud in US education circles.
segments.tr: 最新一轮的评估结果在美国教育界引起了轩然大波。

segments.src: American teenagers posted a reading rank of 13th and a math rank of 27th among participating education systems, according to the newest data — scores that put the country at or near its lowest standing in more than twenty years of testing.
segments.tr: 最新数据显示，在参与评估的教育系统中，美国青少年的阅读排名为第 13 位，数学排名为第 27 位。这些分数使该国处于或接近其二十多年测试历史中的最低水平。

segments.src: For a nation that has long framed itself as a global leader in innovation and higher education, the numbers have reignited a familiar but increasingly urgent question: what's going wrong in K-12 classrooms?
segments.tr: 对于一个长期自诩为全球创新和高等教育领头羊的国家来说，这些数字重新引发了一个熟悉但日益紧迫的问题：K-12 课堂到底出了什么问题？

segments.src: ## Reading Holds Up Better Than Math
segments.tr: ## 阅读表现好于数学

segments.src: The split between the two subjects is telling.
segments.tr: 这两个学科之间的差距发人深省。

segments.src: A 13th-place reading rank isn't a disaster on its own — many countries cluster tightly in the middle of the pack, and small score differences can shuffle rankings significantly.
segments.tr: 阅读排名第 13 位本身并不是一场灾难——许多国家都紧密地聚集在中游，微小的分数差异就可能使排名发生显著变化。

segments.src: Math is a different story.
segments.tr: 数学则是另一回事。

segments.src: A 27th-place finish places the US behind most other advanced economies and well below the OECD average, continuing a slide that predates the pandemic but appears to have accelerated sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: 第 27 位的成绩使美国落后于大多数其他发达经济体，且远低于 OECD 的平均水平，延续了在疫情前就已开始、但在近年来似乎急剧加速的下滑趋势。

segments.src: Education researchers point to a mix of contributing factors rather than a single cause:
segments.tr: 教育研究人员指出，这是多种因素共同作用的结果，而非单一原因：

segments.src: - **Pandemic-era disruption.** Extended remote and hybrid learning during 2020 and 2021 is widely believed to have interrupted the steady, sequential skill-building that math in particular requires.
segments.tr: - **疫情时期的干扰。** 2020 年和 2021 年期间长期的远程和混合学习被广泛认为中断了数学特别需要的循序渐进、连续性的技能构建。

segments.src: - **Chronic absenteeism.** Attendance data in many districts has not fully recovered to pre-pandemic levels, and missed classroom time compounds quickly in math, where each concept builds on the last.
segments.tr: - **长期缺勤。** 许多学区的出勤率数据尚未完全恢复到疫情前的水平，而缺课时间在数学中会迅速累积，因为数学的每个概念都是建立在上一个概念之上的。

segments.src: - **Uneven recovery efforts.** Federal relief funding aimed at academic recovery has largely expired, and results have varied widely by state and district, suggesting no single intervention has closed the gap nationally.
segments.tr: - **恢复工作不均衡。** 旨在促进学术恢复的联邦救济资金已基本到期，而各州和各学区的效果差异很大，这表明没有单一的干预措施在全国范围内缩小了这一差距。

segments.src: - **Widening gaps between students.** Multiple assessments, including domestic tests like the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), have shown that lower-performing students fell further behind during this period, which can drag down national averages even when top performers hold steady.
segments.tr: - **学生之间的差距拉大。** 包括国家教育进展评估（NAEP）等国内测试在内的多项评估表明，在此期间，表现较差的学生落后得更远，即使顶尖学生保持稳定，这也可能会拉低全国平均水平。

segments.src: ## Why Economists Are Paying Attention
segments.tr: ## 为什么经济学家在关注

segments.src: PISA scores aren't just a matter of academic pride.
segments.tr: PISA 成绩不仅关系到学术声誉。

segments.src: Economists who study human capital have long argued that a country's long-run productivity and competitiveness track closely with the math and problem-solving skills of its workforce.
segments.tr: 研究人力资本的经济学家长期以来一直认为，一个国家的长期生产力和竞争力与其劳动力的数学和解决问题能力密切相关。

segments.src: As industries increasingly lean on data analysis, automation, and technical trades, a generation entering the workforce with weaker quantitative foundations could face a harder time filling — or being prepared for — higher-skilled, higher-wage jobs.
segments.tr: 随着各行各业越来越依赖数据分析、自动化和技术工种，带着较弱的定量基础进入职场的一代人可能会在填补（或准备好从事）高技能、高薪工作时面临更大的困难。

segments.src: Business groups and workforce-development organizations have flagged this concern in recent years, noting that employers already report difficulty finding applicants with adequate math and technical readiness for skilled roles, from manufacturing to healthcare technology.
segments.tr: 商业团体和劳动力发展组织近年来也指出了这一担忧，并提到雇主已经反映，很难找到在数学和技术准备方面达到要求的人选来担任从制造业到医疗保健技术等领域的专业岗位。

segments.src: A prolonged dip in foundational math skills, some economists caution, could show up years from now as a drag on productivity growth rather than an immediate crisis.
segments.tr: 一些经济学家警告说，基础数学技能的长期下滑可能会在多年后表现为对生产力增长的拖累，而不是眼前的危机。

segments.src: ## A Familiar Debate, With New Urgency
segments.tr: ## 带有新紧迫感的熟悉辩论

segments.src: The results have renewed a long-running debate among educators, parents, and policymakers over how to respond.
segments.tr: 这些结果让教育工作者、家长和政策制定者之间关于如何应对的长期辩论重新升温。

segments.src: Some argue for doubling down on high-dosage tutoring programs, which have shown promise in randomized studies for accelerating math recovery.
segments.tr: 一些人主张加大对高强度辅导计划的投入，这些计划在随机研究中已显示出加速数学恢复的成效。

segments.src: Others point to curriculum standards, teacher shortages in STEM subjects, and the growing presence of smartphones and social media in classrooms as areas needing attention.
segments.tr: 另一些人则指出，课程标准、STEM 学科教师短缺以及智能手机和社交媒体在课堂上日益增加的影响力都是需要关注的领域。

segments.src: There is broad agreement on at least one point: there is no single fix, and any recovery will likely take years, not one school cycle, to materialize in test scores.
segments.tr: 至少在一点上存在广泛共识：没有单一的解决办法，任何恢复都可能需要数年时间，而不是一个学年就能在测试成绩中体现出来。

segments.src: It's also worth noting that the US has never topped PISA rankings, even in stronger years — a mix of income inequality, decentralized school funding, and demographic diversity has long made direct comparisons with smaller, more centralized education systems tricky.
segments.tr: 同样值得注意的是，即使在表现较好的年份，美国也从未在 PISA 排名中名列前茅——收入不平等、地方分权的学校资金以及人口多样性，长期以来使得将美国与规模较小、更为集权的教育系统进行直接比较变得非常复杂。

segments.src: Still, the direction of the trend, rather than the absolute rank, is what has caught the attention of researchers: a consistent decline over multiple testing cycles is harder to dismiss as noise.
segments.tr: 然而，引起研究人员关注的是趋势的方向，而非绝对排名：在多个测试周期中持续下滑，很难再被简单地斥为偶然波动。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Expect the new scores to feature heavily in state and local budget debates over the next school year, as districts weigh how to allocate shrinking pandemic-relief dollars toward tutoring, literacy coaching, and math intervention programs.
segments.tr: 预计在下一个学年，新的分数将成为州和地方预算辩论的重头戏，因为各学区正在权衡如何将日益缩减的疫情救济资金分配给辅导、读写指导和数学干预项目。

segments.src: Parents may also see more schools experimenting with phone-free classroom policies and revised math curricula aimed at rebuilding foundational skills earlier.
segments.tr: 家长们可能还会看到更多学校尝试推行无手机课堂政策，并修改数学课程，以期在更早阶段重建基础技能。

segments.src: For now, the PISA results serve as a data point rather than a verdict — a reminder that the pandemic's effects on education are still working their way through the system, and that closing the gap will likely require sustained attention well beyond the next test cycle in three years.
segments.tr: 目前，PISA 结果只是一个参考数据，而非最终判决——它提醒我们，疫情对教育的影响仍在系统中持续发酵，而缩小差距可能需要持续的关注，远非三年后的下一个测试周期所能解决。

hi.title: रीडिंग में 13वां, मैथ में 27वां स्थान: दो दशकों में अमेरिका के सबसे खराब PISA स्कोर का वास्तव में क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: ## A Sobering Report Card for American Teens
segments.tr: ## अमेरिकी किशोरों के लिए एक गंभीर रिपोर्ट कार्ड

segments.src: Every three years, hundreds of thousands of 15-year-olds around the world sit down for the Programme for International Student Assessment, or PISA — a standardized test run by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) that compares how students in dozens of countries perform in reading, math, and science.
segments.tr: हर तीन साल में, दुनिया भर के लाखों 15 वर्षीय छात्र 'प्रोग्राम फॉर इंटरनेशनल स्टूडेंट असेसमेंट' (PISA) के लिए बैठते हैं — यह 'ऑर्गनाइजेशन फॉर इकोनॉमिक को-ऑपरेशन एंड डेवलपमेंट' (OECD) द्वारा आयोजित एक मानकीकृत परीक्षा है, जो तुलना करती है कि दर्जनों देशों के छात्र रीडिंग, मैथ और साइंस में कैसा प्रदर्शन करते हैं।

segments.src: The latest round of results has landed with a thud in US education circles.
segments.tr: परिणामों का नवीनतम दौर अमेरिकी शिक्षा हलकों में भारी निराशा के साथ आया है।

segments.src: American teenagers posted a reading rank of 13th and a math rank of 27th among participating education systems, according to the newest data — scores that put the country at or near its lowest standing in more than twenty years of testing.
segments.tr: नवीनतम आंकड़ों के अनुसार, भाग लेने वाली शिक्षा प्रणालियों में अमेरिकी किशोरों ने रीडिंग में 13वां और मैथ में 27वां स्थान हासिल किया है — ये ऐसे स्कोर हैं जो देश को परीक्षण के बीस से अधिक वर्षों में इसके सबसे निचले स्तर पर या उसके करीब लाते हैं।

segments.src: For a nation that has long framed itself as a global leader in innovation and higher education, the numbers have reignited a familiar but increasingly urgent question: what's going wrong in K-12 classrooms?
segments.tr: एक ऐसे देश के लिए जिसने लंबे समय से खुद को नवाचार और उच्च शिक्षा में एक वैश्विक नेता के रूप में पेश किया है, इन आंकड़ों ने एक परिचित लेकिन तेजी से बढ़ते हुए जरूरी सवाल को फिर से हवा दे दी है: K-12 कक्षाओं में क्या गलत हो रहा है?

segments.src: ## Reading Holds Up Better Than Math
segments.tr: ## रीडिंग का प्रदर्शन मैथ से बेहतर रहा

segments.src: The split between the two subjects is telling.
segments.tr: दोनों विषयों के बीच का अंतर काफी कुछ बयां करता है।

segments.src: A 13th-place reading rank isn't a disaster on its own — many countries cluster tightly in the middle of the pack, and small score differences can shuffle rankings significantly.
segments.tr: रीडिंग में 13वां स्थान अपने आप में कोई आपदा नहीं है — कई देश बीच के समूह में बहुत करीब होते हैं, और स्कोर में मामूली अंतर रैंकिंग को काफी हद तक बदल सकता है।

segments.src: Math is a different story.
segments.tr: मैथ की कहानी अलग है।

segments.src: A 27th-place finish places the US behind most other advanced economies and well below the OECD average, continuing a slide that predates the pandemic but appears to have accelerated sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: 27वां स्थान अमेरिका को अधिकांश अन्य उन्नत अर्थव्यवस्थाओं से पीछे और OECD औसत से काफी नीचे रखता है, जो एक ऐसी गिरावट को जारी रखता है जो महामारी से पहले शुरू हुई थी लेकिन हाल के वर्षों में तेजी से बढ़ती हुई प्रतीत होती है।

segments.src: Education researchers point to a mix of contributing factors rather than a single cause:
segments.tr: शिक्षा शोधकर्ता किसी एक कारण के बजाय योगदान देने वाले कारकों के मिश्रण की ओर इशारा करते हैं:

segments.src: - **Pandemic-era disruption.** Extended remote and hybrid learning during 2020 and 2021 is widely believed to have interrupted the steady, sequential skill-building that math in particular requires.
segments.tr: - **महामारी के दौर का व्यवधान।** 2020 और 2021 के दौरान लंबे समय तक रिमोट और हाइब्रिड लर्निंग के बारे में व्यापक रूप से माना जाता है कि इसने उस निरंतर, क्रमिक कौशल-निर्माण को बाधित किया जिसकी विशेष रूप से मैथ को आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: - **Chronic absenteeism.** Attendance data in many districts has not fully recovered to pre-pandemic levels, and missed classroom time compounds quickly in math, where each concept builds on the last.
segments.tr: - **लगातार अनुपस्थिति।** कई जिलों में उपस्थिति के आंकड़े महामारी से पहले के स्तर पर पूरी तरह से वापस नहीं आए हैं, और कक्षा का छूटा हुआ समय मैथ में तेजी से असर दिखाता है, जहां प्रत्येक अवधारणा पिछली अवधारणा पर आधारित होती है।

segments.src: - **Uneven recovery efforts.** Federal relief funding aimed at academic recovery has largely expired, and results have varied widely by state and district, suggesting no single intervention has closed the gap nationally.
segments.tr: - **असमान सुधार प्रयास।** शैक्षणिक सुधार के उद्देश्य से मिलने वाली संघीय राहत राशि काफी हद तक समाप्त हो चुकी है, और परिणाम राज्य और जिले के अनुसार व्यापक रूप से भिन्न रहे हैं, जिससे पता चलता है कि किसी भी एकल हस्तक्षेप ने राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर इस अंतर को पाटने का काम नहीं किया है।

segments.src: - **Widening gaps between students.** Multiple assessments, including domestic tests like the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), have shown that lower-performing students fell further behind during this period, which can drag down national averages even when top performers hold steady.
segments.tr: - **छात्रों के बीच बढ़ता अंतर।** 'नेशनल असेसमेंट ऑफ एजुकेशनल प्रोग्रेस' (NAEP) जैसे घरेलू परीक्षणों सहित कई आकलनों से पता चला है कि इस अवधि के दौरान कम प्रदर्शन करने वाले छात्र और पीछे छूट गए, जो शीर्ष प्रदर्शन करने वालों के स्थिर रहने पर भी राष्ट्रीय औसत को नीचे खींच सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why Economists Are Paying Attention
segments.tr: ## अर्थशास्त्री इस पर ध्यान क्यों दे रहे हैं

segments.src: PISA scores aren't just a matter of academic pride.
segments.tr: PISA स्कोर केवल शैक्षणिक गौरव का विषय नहीं हैं।

segments.src: Economists who study human capital have long argued that a country's long-run productivity and competitiveness track closely with the math and problem-solving skills of its workforce.
segments.tr: मानव पूंजी का अध्ययन करने वाले अर्थशास्त्रियों ने लंबे समय से तर्क दिया है कि किसी देश की दीर्घकालिक उत्पादकता और प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता उसके कार्यबल के मैथ और समस्या-समाधान कौशल के साथ निकटता से जुड़ी होती है।

segments.src: As industries increasingly lean on data analysis, automation, and technical trades, a generation entering the workforce with weaker quantitative foundations could face a harder time filling — or being prepared for — higher-skilled, higher-wage jobs.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे उद्योग तेजी से डेटा विश्लेषण, स्वचालन (automation) और तकनीकी व्यवसायों पर निर्भर हो रहे हैं, कमजोर मात्रात्मक आधार के साथ कार्यबल में प्रवेश करने वाली पीढ़ी को उच्च-कौशल, उच्च-वेतन वाली नौकरियों को भरने — या उनके लिए तैयार होने — में अधिक कठिनाई का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: Business groups and workforce-development organizations have flagged this concern in recent years, noting that employers already report difficulty finding applicants with adequate math and technical readiness for skilled roles, from manufacturing to healthcare technology.
segments.tr: व्यावसायिक समूहों और कार्यबल-विकास संगठनों ने हाल के वर्षों में इस चिंता को रेखांकित किया है, यह देखते हुए कि नियोक्ता पहले से ही विनिर्माण से लेकर स्वास्थ्य सेवा तकनीक तक की कुशल भूमिकाओं के लिए पर्याप्त मैथ और तकनीकी तैयारी वाले आवेदकों को खोजने में कठिनाई की रिपोर्ट कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: A prolonged dip in foundational math skills, some economists caution, could show up years from now as a drag on productivity growth rather than an immediate crisis.
segments.tr: कुछ अर्थशास्त्रियों ने चेतावनी दी है कि बुनियादी मैथ कौशल में लंबे समय तक रहने वाली गिरावट तत्काल संकट के बजाय उत्पादकता वृद्धि पर मंदी के रूप में वर्षों बाद दिखाई दे सकती है।

segments.src: ## A Familiar Debate, With New Urgency
segments.tr: ## नई तात्कालिकता के साथ एक परिचित बहस

segments.src: The results have renewed a long-running debate among educators, parents, and policymakers over how to respond.
segments.tr: इन परिणामों ने शिक्षकों, अभिभावकों और नीति निर्माताओं के बीच इस बात को लेकर लंबे समय से चली आ रही बहस को फिर से शुरू कर दिया है कि इस पर कैसे प्रतिक्रिया दी जाए।

segments.src: Some argue for doubling down on high-dosage tutoring programs, which have shown promise in randomized studies for accelerating math recovery.
segments.tr: कुछ लोग हाई-डोज़ ट्यूशन कार्यक्रमों को दोगुना करने का तर्क देते हैं, जिन्होंने मैथ सुधार को गति देने के लिए रैंडमाइज्ड अध्ययनों में उम्मीद जगाई है।

segments.src: Others point to curriculum standards, teacher shortages in STEM subjects, and the growing presence of smartphones and social media in classrooms as areas needing attention.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग पाठ्यक्रम मानकों, STEM विषयों में शिक्षकों की कमी, और कक्षाओं में स्मार्टफोन और सोशल मीडिया की बढ़ती उपस्थिति को ऐसे क्षेत्रों के रूप में इंगित करते हैं जिन पर ध्यान देने की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: There is broad agreement on at least one point: there is no single fix, and any recovery will likely take years, not one school cycle, to materialize in test scores.
segments.tr: कम से कम एक बिंदु पर व्यापक सहमति है: इसका कोई एक समाधान नहीं है, और किसी भी सुधार को परीक्षण स्कोर में दिखने में एक स्कूल चक्र नहीं, बल्कि संभवतः कई साल लगेंगे।

segments.src: It's also worth noting that the US has never topped PISA rankings, even in stronger years — a mix of income inequality, decentralized school funding, and demographic diversity has long made direct comparisons with smaller, more centralized education systems tricky.
segments.tr: यह भी ध्यान देने योग्य है कि अमेरिका ने कभी भी PISA रैंकिंग में शीर्ष स्थान हासिल नहीं किया है, यहां तक कि बेहतर वर्षों में भी नहीं — आय असमानता, विकेंद्रीकृत स्कूल फंडिंग और जनसांख्यिकीय विविधता के मिश्रण ने लंबे समय से छोटे, अधिक केंद्रीकृत शिक्षा प्रणालियों के साथ सीधे तुलना को पेचीदा बना दिया है।

segments.src: Still, the direction of the trend, rather than the absolute rank, is what has caught the attention of researchers: a consistent decline over multiple testing cycles is harder to dismiss as noise.
segments.tr: फिर भी, पूर्ण रैंक के बजाय प्रवृत्ति की दिशा ने शोधकर्ताओं का ध्यान आकर्षित किया है: कई परीक्षण चक्रों में लगातार गिरावट को केवल एक शोर मानकर खारिज करना कठिन है।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Expect the new scores to feature heavily in state and local budget debates over the next school year, as districts weigh how to allocate shrinking pandemic-relief dollars toward tutoring, literacy coaching, and math intervention programs.
segments.tr: उम्मीद करें कि नए स्कोर अगले स्कूल वर्ष में राज्य और स्थानीय बजट बहसों में प्रमुखता से शामिल होंगे, क्योंकि जिले इस बात पर विचार कर रहे हैं कि महामारी-राहत के घटते पैसों को ट्यूशन, साक्षरता कोचिंग और मैथ हस्तक्षेप कार्यक्रमों में कैसे आवंटित किया जाए।

segments.src: Parents may also see more schools experimenting with phone-free classroom policies and revised math curricula aimed at rebuilding foundational skills earlier.
segments.tr: अभिभावक अधिक स्कूलों को फोन-मुक्त कक्षा नीतियों और बुनियादी कौशल को पहले से फिर से बनाने के उद्देश्य से संशोधित मैथ पाठ्यक्रमों के साथ प्रयोग करते हुए भी देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: For now, the PISA results serve as a data point rather than a verdict — a reminder that the pandemic's effects on education are still working their way through the system, and that closing the gap will likely require sustained attention well beyond the next test cycle in three years.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, PISA परिणाम एक फैसले के बजाय एक डेटा बिंदु के रूप में काम करते हैं — एक अनुस्मारक कि शिक्षा पर महामारी के प्रभाव अभी भी प्रणाली के माध्यम से अपना काम कर रहे हैं, और इस अंतर को पाटने के लिए तीन साल में अगले परीक्षण चक्र से कहीं आगे तक निरंतर ध्यान देने की आवश्यकता होगी।

es.title: 13.º en Lectura, 27.º en Matemáticas: lo que realmente significan los peores resultados PISA de EE. UU. en dos décadas

segments.tr: ## Un informe sobrio para los adolescentes estadounidenses

segments.tr: Cada tres años, cientos de miles de jóvenes de 15 años de todo el mundo realizan el Programa para la Evaluación Internacional de los Estudiantes, o PISA, una prueba estandarizada realizada por la Organización para la Cooperación y el Desarrollo Económicos (OECD) que compara el rendimiento de los estudiantes de docenas de países en lectura, matemáticas y ciencias.

segments.src: The latest round of results has landed with a thud in US education circles.
segments.tr: La última ronda de resultados ha caído como un jarro de agua fría en los círculos educativos de EE. UU.

segments.src: American teenagers posted a reading rank of 13th and a math rank of 27th among participating education systems, according to the newest data — scores that put the country at or near its lowest standing in more than twenty years of testing.
segments.tr: Los adolescentes estadounidenses ocuparon el puesto 13.º en lectura y el 27.º en matemáticas entre los sistemas educativos participantes, según los datos más recientes, puntuaciones que sitúan al país en su nivel más bajo, o cerca de él, en más de veinte años de evaluaciones.

segments.src: For a nation that has long framed itself as a global leader in innovation and higher education, the numbers have reignited a familiar but increasingly urgent question: what's going wrong in K-12 classrooms?
segments.tr: Para una nación que durante mucho tiempo se ha considerado un líder mundial en innovación y educación superior, las cifras han reavivado una pregunta familiar pero cada vez más urgente: ¿qué está fallando en las aulas de K-12?

segments.src: ## Reading Holds Up Better Than Math
segments.tr: ## La lectura se mantiene mejor que las matemáticas

segments.src: The split between the two subjects is telling.
segments.tr: La brecha entre las dos materias es reveladora.

segments.src: A 13th-place reading rank isn't a disaster on its own — many countries cluster tightly in the middle of the pack, and small score differences can shuffle rankings significantly.
segments.tr: Un 13.º puesto en lectura no es un desastre por sí solo: muchos países se agrupan estrechamente en la mitad de la tabla, y pequeñas diferencias en la puntuación pueden alterar significativamente las clasificaciones.

segments.src: Math is a different story.
segments.tr: Las matemáticas son una historia diferente.

segments.src: A 27th-place finish places the US behind most other advanced economies and well below the OECD average, continuing a slide that predates the pandemic but appears to have accelerated sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: Un 27.º puesto sitúa a EE. UU. por detrás de la mayoría de las demás economías avanzadas y muy por debajo de la media de la OECD, continuando un descenso que precede a la pandemia pero que parece haberse acelerado bruscamente en los últimos años.

segments.src: Education researchers point to a mix of contributing factors rather than a single cause:
segments.tr: Los investigadores en educación señalan una combinación de factores contribuyentes en lugar de una sola causa:

segments.src: - **Pandemic-era disruption.** Extended remote and hybrid learning during 2020 and 2021 is widely believed to have interrupted the steady, sequential skill-building that math in particular requires.
segments.tr: - **Interrupción en la era de la pandemia.** Se cree ampliamente que el aprendizaje a distancia e híbrido prolongado durante 2020 y 2021 interrumpió el desarrollo constante y secuencial de habilidades que requieren, en particular, las matemáticas.

segments.src: - **Chronic absenteeism.** Attendance data in many districts has not fully recovered to pre-pandemic levels, and missed classroom time compounds quickly in math, where each concept builds on the last.
segments.tr: - **Absentismo crónico.** Los datos de asistencia en muchos distritos no se han recuperado por completo a los niveles previos a la pandemia, y el tiempo de clase perdido se acumula rápidamente en matemáticas, donde cada concepto se construye sobre el anterior.

segments.src: - **Uneven recovery efforts.** Federal relief funding aimed at academic recovery has largely expired, and results have varied widely by state and district, suggesting no single intervention has closed the gap nationally.
segments.tr: - **Esfuerzos de recuperación descompensados.** La financiación de ayuda federal destinada a la recuperación académica ha expirado en su mayor parte, y los resultados han variado ampliamente según el estado y el distrito, lo que sugiere que ninguna intervención única ha cerrado la brecha a nivel nacional.

segments.src: - **Widening gaps between students.** Multiple assessments, including domestic tests like the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), have shown that lower-performing students fell further behind during this period, which can drag down national averages even when top performers hold steady.
segments.tr: - **Brechas crecientes entre estudiantes.** Múltiples evaluaciones, incluidas pruebas nacionales como la Evaluación Nacional del Progreso Educativo (NAEP), han mostrado que los estudiantes de menor rendimiento se quedaron aún más atrás durante este período, lo que puede arrastrar hacia abajo los promedios nacionales incluso cuando los estudiantes de alto rendimiento se mantienen estables.

segments.src: ## Why Economists Are Paying Attention
segments.tr: ## Por qué los economistas están prestando atención

segments.src: PISA scores aren't just a matter of academic pride.
segments.tr: Las puntuaciones de PISA no son solo una cuestión de orgullo académico.

segments.src: Economists who study human capital have long argued that a country's long-run productivity and competitiveness track closely with the math and problem-solving skills of its workforce.
segments.tr: Los economistas que estudian el capital humano han argumentado durante mucho tiempo que la productividad y la competitividad a largo plazo de un país están estrechamente ligadas a las habilidades matemáticas y de resolución de problemas de su fuerza laboral.

segments.src: As industries increasingly lean on data analysis, automation, and technical trades, a generation entering the workforce with weaker quantitative foundations could face a harder time filling — or being prepared for — higher-skilled, higher-wage jobs.
segments.tr: A medida que las industrias se apoyan cada vez más en el análisis de datos, la automatización y los oficios técnicos, una generación que entra en el mercado laboral con bases cuantitativas más débiles podría tener más dificultades para cubrir, o estar preparada para, empleos de mayor cualificación y salarios más altos.

segments.src: Business groups and workforce-development organizations have flagged this concern in recent years, noting that employers already report difficulty finding applicants with adequate math and technical readiness for skilled roles, from manufacturing to healthcare technology.
segments.tr: Los grupos empresariales y las organizaciones de desarrollo de la fuerza laboral han señalado esta preocupación en los últimos años, notando que los empleadores ya informan de dificultades para encontrar candidatos con una preparación matemática y técnica adecuada para puestos cualificados, desde la fabricación hasta la tecnología sanitaria.

segments.src: A prolonged dip in foundational math skills, some economists caution, could show up years from now as a drag on productivity growth rather than an immediate crisis.
segments.tr: Una caída prolongada en las habilidades matemáticas fundamentales, advierten algunos economistas, podría manifestarse dentro de unos años como un freno al crecimiento de la productividad más que como una crisis inmediata.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Debate, With New Urgency
segments.tr: ## Un debate familiar, con una nueva urgencia

segments.src: The results have renewed a long-running debate among educators, parents, and policymakers over how to respond.
segments.tr: Los resultados han renovado un debate prolongado entre educadores, padres y responsables políticos sobre cómo responder.

segments.src: Some argue for doubling down on high-dosage tutoring programs, which have shown promise in randomized studies for accelerating math recovery.
segments.tr: Algunos abogan por redoblar el esfuerzo en programas de tutoría intensiva, que han mostrado resultados prometedores en estudios aleatorizados para acelerar la recuperación en matemáticas.

segments.src: Others point to curriculum standards, teacher shortages in STEM subjects, and the growing presence of smartphones and social media in classrooms as areas needing attention.
segments.tr: Otros señalan los estándares curriculares, la escasez de profesores en materias STEM y la creciente presencia de teléfonos inteligentes y redes sociales en las aulas como áreas que requieren atención.

segments.src: There is broad agreement on at least one point: there is no single fix, and any recovery will likely take years, not one school cycle, to materialize in test scores.
segments.tr: Existe un amplio acuerdo en al menos un punto: no hay una solución única, y cualquier recuperación probablemente tardará años, no un solo ciclo escolar, en materializarse en las puntuaciones de las pruebas.

segments.src: It's also worth noting that the US has never topped PISA rankings, even in stronger years — a mix of income inequality, decentralized school funding, and demographic diversity has long made direct comparisons with smaller, more centralized education systems tricky.
segments.tr: También vale la pena señalar que EE. UU. nunca ha liderado las clasificaciones de PISA, ni siquiera en los años más fuertes; una combinación de desigualdad de ingresos, financiación escolar descentralizada y diversidad demográfica ha dificultado durante mucho tiempo las comparaciones directas con sistemas educativos más pequeños y centralizados.

segments.src: Still, the direction of the trend, rather than the absolute rank, is what has caught the attention of researchers: a consistent decline over multiple testing cycles is harder to dismiss as noise.
segments.tr: Aun así, la dirección de la tendencia, más que el puesto absoluto, es lo que ha llamado la atención de los investigadores: un descenso constante a lo largo de múltiples ciclos de evaluación es más difícil de descartar como simple ruido.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué ocurre a continuación

segments.src: Expect the new scores to feature heavily in state and local budget debates over the next school year, as districts weigh how to allocate shrinking pandemic-relief dollars toward tutoring, literacy coaching, and math intervention programs.
segments.tr: Se espera que las nuevas puntuaciones ocupen un lugar destacado en los debates presupuestarios estatales y locales durante el próximo curso escolar, a medida que los distritos sopesan cómo asignar los reducidos fondos de ayuda por la pandemia a programas de tutoría, entrenamiento en lectoescritura e intervención en matemáticas.

segments.src: Parents may also see more schools experimenting with phone-free classroom policies and revised math curricula aimed at rebuilding foundational skills earlier.
segments.tr: Los padres también pueden ver más escuelas experimentando con políticas de aulas libres de teléfonos y planes de estudio de matemáticas revisados destinados a reconstruir las habilidades fundamentales desde más temprano.

segments.src: For now, the PISA results serve as a data point rather than a verdict — a reminder that the pandemic's effects on education are still working their way through the system, and that closing the gap will likely require sustained attention well beyond the next test cycle in three years.
segments.tr: Por ahora, los resultados de PISA sirven como un dato más que como un veredicto: un recordatorio de que los efectos de la pandemia en la educación aún se están abriendo paso en el sistema, y que cerrar la brecha probablemente requerirá una atención sostenida mucho más allá del próximo ciclo de pruebas dentro de tres años.

segments.tr: Pour une nation qui s'est longtemps présentée comme un leader mondial de l'innovation et de l'enseignement supérieur, ces chiffres ont relancé une question familière mais de plus en plus urgente : que se passe-t-il dans les salles de classe de la maternelle à la terminale (K-12) ?

segments.src: ## Reading Holds Up Better Than Math
segments.tr: ## La lecture résiste mieux que les mathématiques

segments.src: The split between the two subjects is telling.
segments.tr: Le fossé entre les deux matières est révélateur.

segments.src: A 13th-place reading rank isn't a disaster on its own — many countries cluster tightly in the middle of the pack, and small score differences can shuffle rankings significantly.
segments.tr: Une 13e place en lecture n'est pas un désastre en soi — de nombreux pays se regroupent étroitement au milieu du peloton, et de faibles différences de score peuvent modifier considérablement les classements.

segments.src: Math is a different story.
segments.tr: Les mathématiques sont une autre histoire.

segments.src: A 27th-place finish places the US behind most other advanced economies and well below the OECD average, continuing a slide that predates the pandemic but appears to have accelerated sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: Une 27e place place les États-Unis derrière la plupart des autres économies avancées et bien en dessous de la moyenne de l'OCDE, poursuivant une glissade qui précède la pandémie mais qui semble s'être fortement accélérée ces dernières années.

segments.src: Education researchers point to a mix of contributing factors rather than a single cause:
segments.tr: Les chercheurs en éducation pointent du doigt une combinaison de facteurs contributifs plutôt qu'une cause unique :

segments.src: - **Pandemic-era disruption.** Extended remote and hybrid learning during 2020 and 2021 is widely believed to have interrupted the steady, sequential skill-building that math in particular requires.
segments.tr: - **Perturbations liées à l'ère de la pandémie.** L'apprentissage à distance et hybride prolongé au cours de 2020 et 2021 est largement considéré comme ayant interrompu le développement constant et séquentiel des compétences que les mathématiques, en particulier, exigent.

segments.src: - **Chronic absenteeism.** Attendance data in many districts has not fully recovered to pre-pandemic levels, and missed classroom time compounds quickly in math, where each concept builds on the last.
segments.tr: - **Absentéisme chronique.** Les données de fréquentation dans de nombreux districts ne sont pas revenues aux niveaux d'avant la pandémie, et le temps de classe manqué s'accumule rapidement en mathématiques, où chaque concept s'appuie sur le précédent.

segments.src: - **Uneven recovery efforts.** Federal relief funding aimed at academic recovery has largely expired, and results have varied widely by state and district, suggesting no single intervention has closed the gap nationally.
segments.tr: - **Efforts de récupération inégaux.** Les fonds de secours fédéraux destinés à la récupération académique ont largement expiré, et les résultats ont varié considérablement selon les États et les districts, suggérant qu'aucune intervention unique n'a comblé l'écart à l'échelle nationale.

segments.src: - **Widening gaps between students.** Multiple assessments, including domestic tests like the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), have shown that lower-performing students fell further behind during this period, which can drag down national averages even when top performers hold steady.
segments.tr: - **Élargissement des écarts entre les élèves.** De multiples évaluations, y compris des tests nationaux comme le National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), ont montré que les élèves les moins performants ont pris davantage de retard au cours de cette période, ce qui peut tirer les moyennes nationales vers le bas même lorsque les élèves les plus performants restent stables.

segments.src: ## Why Economists Are Paying Attention
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les économistes sont attentifs

segments.src: PISA scores aren't just a matter of academic pride.
segments.tr: Les scores PISA ne sont pas seulement une question de fierté académique.

segments.src: Economists who study human capital have long argued that a country's long-run productivity and competitiveness track closely with the math and problem-solving skills of its workforce.
segments.tr: Les économistes qui étudient le capital humain soutiennent depuis longtemps que la productivité et la compétitivité à long terme d'un pays sont étroitement liées aux compétences en mathématiques et en résolution de problèmes de sa main-d'œuvre.

segments.src: As industries increasingly lean on data analysis, automation, and technical trades, a generation entering the workforce with weaker quantitative foundations could face a harder time filling — or being prepared for — higher-skilled, higher-wage jobs.
segments.tr: Alors que les industries s'appuient de plus en plus sur l'analyse de données, l'automatisation et les métiers techniques, une génération entrant sur le marché du travail avec des bases quantitatives plus faibles pourrait avoir plus de difficultés à occuper — ou à être préparée pour — des emplois plus qualifiés et mieux rémunérés.

segments.src: Business groups and workforce-development organizations have flagged this concern in recent years, noting that employers already report difficulty finding applicants with adequate math and technical readiness for skilled roles, from manufacturing to healthcare technology.
segments.tr: Les groupes d'entreprises et les organisations de développement de la main-d'œuvre ont souligné cette préoccupation ces dernières années, notant que les employeurs signalent déjà des difficultés à trouver des candidats ayant une préparation mathématique et technique adéquate pour des rôles qualifiés, de la fabrication à la technologie de la santé.

segments.src: A prolonged dip in foundational math skills, some economists caution, could show up years from now as a drag on productivity growth rather than an immediate crisis.
segments.tr: Une baisse prolongée des compétences fondamentales en mathématiques, préviennent certains économistes, pourrait apparaître dans des années comme un frein à la croissance de la productivité plutôt que comme une crise immédiate.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Debate, With New Urgency
segments.tr: ## Un débat familier, avec une nouvelle urgence

segments.src: The results have renewed a long-running debate among educators, parents, and policymakers over how to respond.
segments.tr: Les résultats ont relancé un débat de longue date parmi les éducateurs, les parents et les décideurs politiques sur la manière de réagir.

segments.src: Some argue for doubling down on high-dosage tutoring programs, which have shown promise in randomized studies for accelerating math recovery.
segments.tr: Certains préconisent de renforcer les programmes de tutorat intensif, qui ont montré des résultats prometteurs dans des études randomisées pour accélérer le rattrapage en mathématiques.

segments.src: Others point to curriculum standards, teacher shortages in STEM subjects, and the growing presence of smartphones and social media in classrooms as areas needing attention.
segments.tr: D'autres pointent du doigt les normes des programmes scolaires, les pénuries d'enseignants dans les matières STIM (sciences, technologies, ingénierie et mathématiques) et la présence croissante des smartphones et des réseaux sociaux dans les salles de classe comme des domaines nécessitant une attention particulière.

segments.src: There is broad agreement on at least one point: there is no single fix, and any recovery will likely take years, not one school cycle, to materialize in test scores.
segments.tr: Il existe un large consensus sur au moins un point : il n'y a pas de solution unique, et tout rétablissement prendra probablement des années, et non un seul cycle scolaire, pour se concrétiser dans les résultats des tests.

segments.src: It's also worth noting that the US has never topped PISA rankings, even in stronger years — a mix of income inequality, decentralized school funding, and demographic diversity has long made direct comparisons with smaller, more centralized education systems tricky.
segments.tr: Il convient également de noter que les États-Unis n'ont jamais été en tête des classements PISA, même lors des années plus fortes — un mélange d'inégalités de revenus, de financement décentralisé des écoles et de diversité démographique a longtemps rendu les comparaisons directes avec des systèmes éducatifs plus petits et plus centralisés délicates.

segments.src: Still, the direction of the trend, rather than the absolute rank, is what has caught the attention of researchers: a consistent decline over multiple testing cycles is harder to dismiss as noise.
segments.tr: Pourtant, c'est la direction de la tendance, plutôt que le classement absolu, qui a attiré l'attention des chercheurs : un déclin constant sur plusieurs cycles de test est plus difficile à écarter comme étant du bruit.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passera-t-il ensuite

segments.src: Expect the new scores to feature heavily in state and local budget debates over the next school year, as districts weigh how to allocate shrinking pandemic-relief dollars toward tutoring, literacy coaching, and math intervention programs.
segments.tr: Attendez-vous à ce que les nouveaux scores occupent une place importante dans les débats budgétaires locaux et étatiques au cours de la prochaine année scolaire, alors que les districts évaluent comment allouer les fonds de secours liés à la pandémie, qui diminuent, au tutorat, au coaching en littératie et aux programmes d'intervention en mathématiques.

segments.src: Parents may also see more schools experimenting with phone-free classroom policies and revised math curricula aimed at rebuilding foundational skills earlier.
segments.tr: Les parents pourraient également voir davantage d'écoles expérimenter des politiques de classe sans téléphone et des programmes de mathématiques révisés visant à reconstruire les compétences fondamentales plus tôt.

segments.src: For now, the PISA results serve as a data point rather than a verdict — a reminder that the pandemic's effects on education are still working their way through the system, and that closing the gap will likely require sustained attention well beyond the next test cycle in three years.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les résultats du PISA servent de point de données plutôt que de verdict — un rappel que les effets de la pandémie sur l'éducation continuent de se faire sentir dans le système, et que combler l'écart nécessitera probablement une attention soutenue bien au-delà du prochain cycle de test dans trois ans.

segments.tr: A rodada mais recente de resultados caiu como uma bomba nos círculos educacionais dos EUA.

segments.src: For a nation that has long framed itself as a global leader in innovation and higher education, the numbers have reignited a familiar but increasingly urgent question: what's going wrong in K-12 classrooms?

segments.src: - **Uneven recovery efforts.** Federal relief funding aimed at academic recovery has largely expired, and results have varied widely by state and district, suggesting no single intervention has closed the gap nationally.
segments.tr: - **Esforços de recuperação desiguais.** O financiamento federal de ajuda voltado para a recuperação acadêmica expirou em grande parte, e os resultados variaram amplamente entre estados e distritos, sugerindo que nenhuma intervenção isolada fechou a lacuna nacionalmente.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next

segments.src: As industries increasingly lean on data analysis, automation, and technical trades, a generation entering the workforce with weaker quantitative foundations could face a harder time filling — or being prepared for — higher-skilled, higher-wage jobs.
segments.tr: Seiring industri yang semakin mengandalkan analisis data, otomatisasi, dan perdagangan teknis, generasi yang memasuki dunia kerja dengan landasan kuantitatif yang lebih lemah mungkin akan menghadapi masa yang lebih sulit untuk mengisi — atau dipersiapkan untuk — pekerjaan yang membutuhkan keterampilan dan upah lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Business groups and workforce-development organizations have flagged this concern in recent years, noting that employers already report difficulty finding applicants with adequate math and technical readiness for skilled roles, from manufacturing to healthcare technology.
segments.tr: Kelompok bisnis dan organisasi pengembangan tenaga kerja telah mengangkat kekhawatiran ini dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, mencatat bahwa para pemberi kerja telah melaporkan kesulitan menemukan pelamar dengan kesiapan matematika dan teknis yang memadai untuk peran terampil, dari manufaktur hingga teknologi layanan kesehatan.

segments.src: A prolonged dip in foundational math skills, some economists caution, could show up years from now as a drag on productivity growth rather than an immediate crisis.
segments.tr: Penurunan berkepanjangan dalam keterampilan matematika dasar, beberapa ekonom memperingatkan, dapat muncul bertahun-tahun dari sekarang sebagai beban pada pertumbuhan produktivitas alih-alih sebagai krisis langsung.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Debate, With New Urgency

segments.src: The results have renewed a long-running debate among educators, parents, and policymakers over how to respond.

segments.src: Some argue for doubling down on high-dosage tutoring programs, which have shown promise in randomized studies for accelerating math recovery.
segments.tr: Beberapa pihak berargumen untuk menggandakan program bimbingan belajar dosis tinggi, yang telah menunjukkan harapan dalam studi acak untuk mempercepat pemulihan matematika.

segments.src: Others point to curriculum standards, teacher shortages in STEM subjects, and the growing presence of smartphones and social media in classrooms as areas needing attention.
segments.tr: Yang lain menunjuk pada standar kurikulum, kekurangan guru dalam mata pelajaran STEM, dan meningkatnya kehadiran ponsel pintar dan media sosial di ruang kelas sebagai area yang memerlukan perhatian.

segments.src: There is broad agreement on at least one point: there is no single fix, and any recovery will likely take years, not one school cycle, to materialize in test scores.
segments.tr: Ada kesepakatan luas tentang setidaknya satu hal: tidak ada satu solusi tunggal, dan pemulihan apa pun kemungkinan akan memakan waktu bertahun-tahun, bukan satu siklus sekolah, untuk terwujud dalam skor tes.

segments.src: It's also worth noting that the US has never topped PISA rankings, even in stronger years — a mix of income inequality, decentralized school funding, and demographic diversity has long made direct comparisons with smaller, more centralized education systems tricky.
segments.tr: Perlu juga dicatat bahwa AS tidak pernah menduduki puncak peringkat PISA, bahkan pada tahun-tahun yang lebih kuat — perpaduan antara ketimpangan pendapatan, pendanaan sekolah yang terdesentralisasi, dan keragaman demografis telah lama membuat perbandingan langsung dengan sistem pendidikan yang lebih kecil dan lebih terpusat menjadi rumit.

segments.src: Still, the direction of the trend, rather than the absolute rank, is what has caught the attention of researchers: a consistent decline over multiple testing cycles is harder to dismiss as noise.
segments.tr: Namun, arah tren tersebut, alih-alih peringkat absolutnya, adalah apa yang telah menarik perhatian para peneliti: penurunan yang konsisten selama beberapa siklus pengujian lebih sulit untuk diabaikan begitu saja sebagai kebisingan data.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next

segments.src: Expect the new scores to feature heavily in state and local budget debates over the next school year, as districts weigh how to allocate shrinking pandemic-relief dollars toward tutoring, literacy coaching, and math intervention programs.
segments.tr: Perkirakan skor baru ini akan mendominasi perdebatan anggaran negara bagian dan lokal selama tahun ajaran berikutnya, saat distrik menimbang bagaimana mengalokasikan dana bantuan pandemi yang menyusut untuk bimbingan belajar, pelatihan literasi, dan program intervensi matematika.

segments.src: Parents may also see more schools experimenting with phone-free classroom policies and revised math curricula aimed at rebuilding foundational skills earlier.
segments.tr: Orang tua juga mungkin melihat lebih banyak sekolah yang mencoba kebijakan kelas bebas ponsel dan kurikulum matematika yang direvisi yang bertujuan untuk membangun kembali keterampilan dasar lebih awal.

segments.src: For now, the PISA results serve as a data point rather than a verdict — a reminder that the pandemic's effects on education are still working their way through the system, and that closing the gap will likely require sustained attention well beyond the next test cycle in three years.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, hasil PISA berfungsi sebagai titik data alih-alih sebuah vonis — sebuah pengingat bahwa dampak pandemi pada pendidikan masih terus berjalan melalui sistem, dan bahwa menutup kesenjangan tersebut kemungkinan akan membutuhkan perhatian yang berkelanjutan jauh melampaui siklus tes berikutnya dalam tiga tahun.

ja.title: 読解力13位、数学27位：過去20年で最悪となったアメリカのPISA成績が本当に意味すること

segments.src: ## A Sobering Report Card for American Teens
segments.tr: ## アメリカのティーンエイジャーにとっての厳しい通信簿

segments.src: Every three years, hundreds of thousands of 15-year-olds around the world sit down for the Programme for International Student Assessment, or PISA — a standardized test run by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) that compares how students in dozens of countries perform in reading, math, and science.
segments.tr: 3年ごとに、世界中の何十万人もの15歳が、OECD（経済協力開発機構）が実施する標準化テストであるPISA（国際学習到達度調査）に臨む。これは、数十カ国の生徒が読解力、数学、科学でどのような成績を収めているかを比較するものである。

segments.src: The latest round of results has landed with a thud in US education circles.
segments.tr: 最新の結果は、米国の教育界に重い衝撃を与えた。

segments.src: American teenagers posted a reading rank of 13th and a math rank of 27th among participating education systems, according to the newest data — scores that put the country at or near its lowest standing in more than twenty years of testing.
segments.tr: 最新のデータによると、アメリカのティーンエイジャーの順位は参加教育システムの中で読解力が13位、数学が27位であった。このスコアは、20年以上にわたるテストの歴史において、過去最低かそれに近い水準にあることを示している。

segments.src: For a nation that has long framed itself as a global leader in innovation and higher education, the numbers have reignited a familiar but increasingly urgent question: what's going wrong in K-12 classrooms?
segments.tr: 長年にわたりイノベーションと高等教育の世界的リーダーと自負してきた国家にとって、この数字は、K-12（幼稚園から高校まで）の教室で何が間違っているのかという、おなじみでありながらますます切実な疑問を再び呼び起こしている。

segments.src: ## Reading Holds Up Better Than Math
segments.tr: ## 数学よりも持ちこたえる読解力

segments.src: The split between the two subjects is telling.
segments.tr: 2つの教科の間のギャップは雄弁に物語っている。

segments.src: A 13th-place reading rank isn't a disaster on its own — many countries cluster tightly in the middle of the pack, and small score differences can shuffle rankings significantly.
segments.tr: 読解力の13位という順位はそれ自体が致命的な災害というわけではない。多くの国が中位に密集しており、わずかなスコアの違いで順位が大きく入れ替わることがあるからだ。

segments.src: Math is a different story.
segments.tr: 数学は全く別の話である。

segments.src: A 27th-place finish places the US behind most other advanced economies and well below the OECD average, continuing a slide that predates the pandemic but appears to have accelerated sharply in recent years.
segments.tr: 27位という順位は、米国が他の先進国の大部分に後れを取っており、OECDの平均を大きく下回っていることを示している。これはパンデミック以前から始まっていた下落傾向であり、近年になって急激に加速しているように見える。

segments.src: Education researchers point to a mix of contributing factors rather than a single cause:
segments.tr: 教育研究者たちは、単一の原因ではなく、複数の要因が絡み合っていると指摘している。

segments.src: - **Pandemic-era disruption.** Extended remote and hybrid learning during 2020 and 2021 is widely believed to have interrupted the steady, sequential skill-building that math in particular requires.
segments.tr: - **パンデミック期の混乱。** 2020年から2021にかけての長期にわたるオンラインおよびハイブリッド学習は、特に数学に必要な、着実で順序立てたスキル構築を中断させたと広く信じられている。

segments.src: - **Chronic absenteeism.** Attendance data in many districts has not fully recovered to pre-pandemic levels, and missed classroom time compounds quickly in math, where each concept builds on the last.
segments.tr: - **慢性的な欠席。** 多くの地区での出席データはパンデミック前の水準まで完全に回復しておらず、授業を欠席した時間は数学において急速に悪影響を蓄積させる。数学ではすべての概念が前の概念の上に築かれるからである。

segments.src: - **Uneven recovery efforts.** Federal relief funding aimed at academic recovery has largely expired, and results have varied widely by state and district, suggesting no single intervention has closed the gap nationally.
segments.tr: - **不均一な回復への取り組み。** 学力回復を目的とした連邦の救済資金は概ね期限切れとなっており、その結果は州や地区によって大きく異なっている。これは、全国的なギャップを埋めるような単一の介入策が存在しなかったことを示唆している。

segments.src: - **Widening gaps between students.** Multiple assessments, including domestic tests like the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP), have shown that lower-performing students fell further behind during this period, which can drag down national averages even when top performers hold steady.
segments.tr: - **生徒間の格差の拡大。** ナショナル・アセスメント（NAEP）などの国内テストを含む複数の評価において、成績下位の生徒はこの期間にさらに後れを取ったことが示されている。これにより、上位層の成績が安定していても、全国平均が押し下げられる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## Why Economists Are Paying Attention
segments.tr: ## 経済学者たちが注目している理由

segments.src: PISA scores aren't just a matter of academic pride.
segments.tr: PISAのスコアは単なる学問的な誇りの問題ではない。

segments.src: Economists who study human capital have long argued that a country's long-run productivity and competitiveness track closely with the math and problem-solving skills of its workforce.
segments.tr: 人的資本を研究する経済学者たちは、国の長期的な生産性と競争力は、労働者の数学および問題解決能力と密接に連動していると長く主張してきた。

segments.src: As industries increasingly lean on data analysis, automation, and technical trades, a generation entering the workforce with weaker quantitative foundations could face a harder time filling — or being prepared for — higher-skilled, higher-wage jobs.
segments.tr: 産業界がデータ分析、自動化、技術職にますます依存するようになるにつれて、より脆弱な量的基礎を持って労働市場に参入する世代は、より高度で高賃金の仕事に就くこと、あるいはその準備をすることがより難しくなる可能性がある。

segments.src: Business groups and workforce-development organizations have flagged this concern in recent years, noting that employers already report difficulty finding applicants with adequate math and technical readiness for skilled roles, from manufacturing to healthcare technology.
segments.tr: ビジネス団体や人材開発組織は近年この懸念を表明しており、雇用主が製造業から医療技術に至るまで、熟練した役割に必要な数学や技術的準備が整った応募者を見つけるのがすでに難しくなっていると指摘している。

segments.src: A prolonged dip in foundational math skills, some economists caution, could show up years from now as a drag on productivity growth rather than an immediate crisis.
segments.tr: 基礎的な数学スキルの長期的な低迷は、一部の経済学者が警告するように、差し迫った危機としてではなく、数年後に生産性成長の足かせとして現れる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## A Familiar Debate, With New Urgency
segments.tr: ## おなじみの議論と、新たな切実さ

segments.src: The results have renewed a long-running debate among educators, parents, and policymakers over how to respond.
segments.tr: この結果は、どのように対応すべきかについて、教育者、保護者、政策立案者の間で長年の議論を再燃させている。

segments.src: Some argue for doubling down on high-dosage tutoring programs, which have shown promise in randomized studies for accelerating math recovery.
segments.tr: 数学の回復を加速させるために無作為化比較試験で効果が示されている、高頻度の個別指導プログラムに注力すべきだと主張する者もいる。

segments.src: Others point to curriculum standards, teacher shortages in STEM subjects, and the growing presence of smartphones and social media in classrooms as areas needing attention.
segments.tr: 一方で、カリキュラムの基準、STEM分野の教員不足、そして教室におけるスマートフォンやソーシャルメディアの存在感の高まりを、注意が必要な領域として指摘する者もいる。

segments.src: There is broad agreement on at least one point: there is no single fix, and any recovery will likely take years, not one school cycle, to materialize in test scores.
segments.tr: 少なくとも1つの点については幅広い合意がある。単一の解決策など存在せず、いかなる回復も、テストのスコアに表れるには1つの学校サイクルではなく、おそらく何年もかかるということだ。

segments.src: It's also worth noting that the US has never topped PISA rankings, even in stronger years — a mix of income inequality, decentralized school funding, and demographic diversity has long made direct comparisons with smaller, more centralized education systems tricky.
segments.tr: また、米国がより成績の良かった時期であっても、PISAのランキングでトップになったことは一度もないということも言及に値する。所得格差、分散型の学校資金調達、人口動態の多様性が入り交じっているため、より小規模で中央集権的な教育システムとの直接的な比較は、長年にわたって困難なものとなっている。

segments.src: Still, the direction of the trend, rather than the absolute rank, is what has caught the attention of researchers: a consistent decline over multiple testing cycles is harder to dismiss as noise.
segments.tr: それでも、絶対的な順位ではなく、トレンドの方向性こそが研究者たちの注目を集めている。複数のテストサイクルにわたる一貫した低下は、単なるノイズとして片付けるのが難しいからだ。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起きるのか

segments.src: Expect the new scores to feature heavily in state and local budget debates over the next school year, as districts weigh how to allocate shrinking pandemic-relief dollars toward tutoring, literacy coaching, and math intervention programs.
segments.tr: 新しいスコアは、次の学年にかけて州や地域の予算議論において大々的に取り上げられることが予想される。地区が、縮小するパンデミック救済資金を個別指導、リテラシー指導、数学介入プログラムにどのように配分すべきかを検討するためである。

segments.src: Parents may also see more schools experimenting with phone-free classroom policies and revised math curricula aimed at rebuilding foundational skills earlier.
segments.tr: 保護者もまた、基礎的なスキルをより早い段階で再構築することを目指した、スマートフォン禁止の教室方針や改訂された数学カリキュラムを試行する学校を目にすることになるかもしれない。

segments.src: For now, the PISA results serve as a data point rather than a verdict — a reminder that the pandemic's effects on education are still working their way through the system, and that closing the gap will likely require sustained attention well beyond the next test cycle in three years.
segments.tr: 当面の間、PISAの結果は判決というよりもデータポイントとして機能している。それは、パンデミックが教育に及ぼした影響が今なおシステム内を波及し続けており、ギャップを埋めるには3年後の次回のテストサイクルをはるかに越えて、持続的な注意が必要になる可能性が高いということを思い起こさせるものである。
